next.reason: 1985: "must not contain a NEXT GROUP clause unless the description of that report group contains at least one LINE NUMBER clause"; 2023: "NEXT GROUP syntax rules (13.18.37.3) and report group rules (13.15.3) restrict only level and group type; no LINE clause required". 2023 limits NEXT GROUP to level 1 entries and bars it in page heading/report footing, but no rule requires a LINE clause in the group. A group without one is no longer refused.
